critical_code_review_comments: Spec deviation (minor): The task description states 'Connect to Lightspeed button becomes enabled when Client ID and Domain Prefix are filled', but Settings.jsx line 400 also requires Client Secret to be filled. This is actually correct/safer behavior since Client Secret is required for the token exchange, but flag if the product spec meant otherwise.
settings.py line 26: lightspeed_oauth_connected relies on the masked value ('***') check which works but is fragile - would be cleaner to compute it BEFORE masking from the actual token existence.
OAuth state store (_oauth_states in lightspeed.py) is in-memory dict; will lose state on restart or multi-worker deployments. Acceptable for single-worker/preview but not production-safe.
lightspeed.py FRONTEND_URL defaults to '' via os.environ.get with default; if env var missing, redirect URLs and callback URL will be broken silently. Consider failing fast.
API version 2026-01 correctly wired into base URL and connection message.
seed_data_creation: Saved Lightspeed OAuth credentials (redleafssports domain, provided Client ID/Secret) to settings via PUT /api/settings during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 covered Lightspeed OAuth 2.0 pre-auth flow. To test callback, would need to mock http_requests.post in routes/lightspeed.py or use a real authorized code. Test file loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv. Login returns 'token' field. data-testids used: connect-lightspeed-oauth-btn, disconnect-lightspeed-btn, test-lightspeed-btn, login-username, login-password, login-submit.
